transcription.text: This is your banking app. It knows every coffee, every grocery run, every late night order and it tells you exactly what you spend after you've spent it.

What if your bank could help you before? Meet Black Swan. A new tab right inside KBC Mobile. Choose your challenge, choose the fund, where your savings will grow. One tab to opt in and hatch your swan.
From now on you get one number a day. What's left to spend?
Today. No spreadsheets, no lectures, a daily limit. Learn from your own transactions.
Stay under it and your swan thrives. Keep overspending and the weather turns.
Your swan gets tired, then sick and if you let it go, it dies.
One bad day hurts a little, a bad habit hurts a lot.
Every euro you don't spend lands in your buffer.
So when life happens, and your laptop, a bike repair, your buffer catches it.
Not today's limit.
Can't cover it all?
Your limit dips a little, until you've earned it back.
And on payday, your buffer is invested in your KBC funds.
Your lake grows.
Good habits become passive income.
Under the hood?
No black box.
The model reads 90 days of history.
It sets aside rent, bills and subscription.
It flags big one-offs as noise because one expensive purchase doesn't change who you
are.
It learns your baseline and your weekly rhythm.
More room on Saturdays, if that's your night out.
Then it asks you to save 5, 10 or 20%, never more than your income allows.
And it freezes that profile, so saving is never punished with a tighter limit.
Every limit explains itself, line by line.
For KBC, it's one API.
push transactions in, pull the swan back out.
Opt-in only.
Deterministic.
And opting out deletes everything.
- Sophie.
Sophie saves every payday.
Luke is a freelancer with no fixed salary.
It still works.
Emma's routine costs more than she earns.
Jonas splurges the week he gets paid.
Four people, four swans.
- Black swan, for KBC.
Spent with intent.
Keep your swan alive!
